regime: Tech-led selloff with a volatility spike
takeaway: The Nasdaq fell 5.5% and the S&P 500 4.4% Thursday as AI and chip stocks were dumped, and the VIX jumped about 70% to 28. Bonds rallied, with the 2-year yield down about 11 basis points, while gold edged up about 1.5% and silver slipped. This matches past tech-led sell-offs where fear spikes and money moves into bonds; Friday's jobs report is the next test.
